verdict.rationale: Formant is a robotics fleet SaaS platform, not an AI agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The pack shows no MCP server: the 'Formant agent' is on-device robot software, and llms.txt, per-endpoint OpenAPI definitions and SDKs are only adjacent building blocks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
